$comment: Captured from the database the PRE-change prisma/seed.ts produced (issue #712, PP-5.5): roles, permissions and role_permissions by name, the global system_settings row, and the row counts. seed-platform.db.spec.ts proves the registry-driven seed writes exactly this. Do not regenerate it to make a test pass: when seeded data changes on purpose, edit it here in the same commit so the change shows in review. Edited on purpose by issue #723 (PP-6.3): the org_admin role, the four org_* permissions, admin's org grants moved to org_admin, and the scoped role descriptions. Edited on purpose by issue #726 (PP-6.7): the two system permissions organizations:read and organizations:write, granted to admin. Edited on purpose by issue #728 (PP-7.1): the three org permissions groups:read (every org role), groups:write (org_admin, contributor) and groups:admin (org_admin). Edited on purpose by issue #729 (PP-7.2): the three org permissions sharing:read (every org role), sharing:write (org_admin, contributor) and sharing:admin (org_admin). Edited on purpose by issue #733 (PP-8.1): the two org permissions org_settings:read and org_settings:write, granted to org_admin. Edited on purpose by issue #738 (PP-8.5): the two org permissions org_broadcasts:read and org_broadcasts:write, granted to org_admin.
